description: Tools and utilities for extracting genetic information from GGUF models and building specialist genetics profiles

extraction_toolchain.overview: Complete pipeline for analyzing GGUF models and extracting genetic markers

tool_1_gguf_loader.name: GGUF Model Loader
tool_1_gguf_loader.purpose: Load GGUF models and expose structure for analysis
tool_1_gguf_loader.implementation: Rust wrapper around llama.cpp or GGML bindings
tool_1_gguf_loader.data_availability: Ready to use with LM Studio models or any GGUF

tool_2_structural_analyzer.name: Structural Analyzer
tool_2_structural_analyzer.purpose: Extract genetic markers from model structure (not behavior)

analysis_module_1_attention_genetics.description: Analyze attention head structure and patterns

techniques.procedure: For each attention head, compute statistics of query/key/value matrices
Analyze correlations between attention head outputs
Compute attention mechanism's capacity for complex relationships
Analyze feed-forward layer structures and activation functions
Measure information transformation capacity per layer
Analyze skip connections and their gradient flow properties
Perform dimensionality reduction (PCA, UMAP) on embeddings
Identify if embeddings specialize for certain token types
Measure embedding distance for semantically related tokens

analysis_module_4_bias_extraction.description: Identify systematic biases encoded in weights

techniques.procedure: Analyze distribution of weight values for statistical biases
Identify if embeddings are biased toward high-frequency tokens
Measure how biases accumulate through transformer layers

tool_3_behavioral_profiler.name: Behavioral Profiler
tool_3_behavioral_profiler.purpose: Run model on diverse tasks and extract behavioral genetic markers

measurements.captures: Genetic tendency toward verbose vs concise
measurements.method: Collect response lengths across all tests

measurements.captures: How often model expresses uncertainty
measurements.method: Count certainty language patterns

measurements.captures: How quickly model corrects mistakes in multi-step tasks
measurements.method: Track correction patterns in reasoning tasks

measurements.captures: Repeatability on same prompt (genetic confidence)
measurements.method: Run identical prompts, measure output variance

measurements.captures: Tendency toward novel vs formulaic responses
measurements.method: Measure response diversity and novelty

measurements.captures: Natural task decomposition granularity
measurements.method: Analyze chain-of-thought outputs for step size

measurements.captures: How many reasoning steps model naturally takes
measurements.method: Count intermediate steps in multi-step tasks

measurements.captures: How many alternatives model considers
measurements.method: Measure exploration vs exploitation in reasoning

measurements.captures: Preference for explicit reasoning vs pattern matching
measurements.method: Compare performance on analytical vs intuitive tasks

measurements.captures: How well model uses provided context
measurements.method: Run with and without relevant context, measure improvement

measurements.captures: Bias toward confabulation vs admission of uncertainty
measurements.method: Tasks with missing information, measure false confidence

measurements.captures: Which domains model excels at
measurements.method: Measure per-domain accuracy

tool_4_dag_rag_analyzer.name: DAG/RAG Analyzer
tool_4_dag_rag_analyzer.purpose: Extract genetics specific to complex-thought processes

dag_analysis_module.description: Analyze how model naturally decomposes complex tasks

measurements.method: Present complex task, measure how finely it breaks into steps
measurements.captures: DAG decomposition genetic depth

measurements.method: Present circular and linear dependencies, measure correct modeling
measurements.captures: Genetic ability to model task graphs

measurements.method: Analyze hidden layer outputs between reasoning steps
measurements.captures: How rich are intermediate thought representations

measurements.method: Provide tasks with multiple valid solutions, measure exploration
measurements.captures: DAG path exploration vs commitment genetic tendency

dag_analysis_module.implementation: Use intermediate layer analysis to understand decomposition

rag_analysis_module.description: Analyze information retrieval and synthesis patterns

measurements.method: Provide varied relevance contexts, measure appropriate selection
measurements.captures: RAG relevance judgment genetic stringency

measurements.method: Measure how information is combined in complex responses
measurements.captures: Analytical vs intuitive synthesis genetic bias

measurements.method: Provide conflicting sources, measure priority application
measurements.captures: Source reliability assessment genetics

measurements.method: Measure coherence when integrating multiple retrieved contexts
measurements.captures: Integration quality genes

rag_analysis_module.implementation: Track attention to context windows and synthesis patterns

tool_5_genetic_encoder.name: Genetic Encoder
tool_5_genetic_encoder.purpose: Convert analyzed data into standardized genetic loci format

step_1_normalize_measurements.handling: Use percentile ranking against comparison models

step_2_assign_to_loci.procedure: Map each measurement to genetic locus ID

step_3_generate_epigenetic_state.procedure: Initialize epigenetic markers from structural analysis

tool_6_genetic_database.name: Genetic Database & Storage
tool_6_genetic_database.purpose: Store, query, and manage genetic profiles

end_to_end_extraction_example.scenario: Extract genetics from 13B Llama-2-Chat GGUF model
end_to_end_extraction_example.result: Production-ready genetic profile suitable for specialist assignment or breeding

workflow: 1. User provides path to GGUF models
2. Extraction toolchain analyzes all models in parallel
3. Genetic profiles stored in genetics database
4. Profiles indexed and ready for specialist assignment
5. Breeding operations can use extracted genetics
6. DAG/RAG system benefits from genetically-informed specialization

success_metrics.extraction_fidelity: Exported GGUF using learned genetics exhibits same behavior as original
success_metrics.specialization_effectiveness: Genetic profile predicts specialist performance on role tasks
success_metrics.breeding_success: Offspring of two parents exhibit traits between parents
success_metrics.dag_rag_optimization: Genetically-informed DAG/RAG performs better than baseline
